basic_details.short_information: Indira Gandhi Institute of Medical Science (IGIMS), Patna, Bihar, has invited applications for 5 posts of Driver (Ordinary Grade) under Advt No. 04/Driver/IGIMS/Estt./2026. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 20 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Demand Draft payable to The Director, IGIMS, Patna (non-refundable).

qualification.education_qualification: Valid Driving License for driving heavy vehicles, knowledge of Motor Mechanism and 03 years' experience. Desirable: 8th passed with 03 years' service as Home Guard/Civil Volunteer.
qualification.details: Qualification: Valid Driving License for driving heavy vehicles; Knowledge of Motor Mechanism; Experience 03 Years Experience: 03 Years Age limit: 18 to 30 years (as on 20 December 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST 05 years, EBC (MBC)/BC 03 years, Female candidates (all categories) 03 years, Handicapped As per rule of Govt. of Bihar, Persons working in Government As per rule | Other conditions: | Open to Indian citizens Reservation and age relaxation benefits only for Bihar State domicile; applicants from outside Bihar not entitled to reservation Post is non-practicing; private practice of any kind is prohibited and leads to termination Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification | Desirable: | 8th passed with 03 years' service as Home Guard/Civil Volunteer

how_to_apply: Use the proforma of application attached to the advertisement or downloaded from www.igims.org.
Fill the application neatly typed and complete in all respects.
Attach educational and experience certificates, passport size photograph and the fee Demand Draft payable to The Director, IGIMS, Patna.
Send by Regd. Post/Speed Post/Courier to reach by 20-12-2026 till 4:30 PM.

content_sections.heading: Key Points
content_sections.text: Last date: 20 December 2026 Vacancies: 5 How to apply: Offline, by post or in person as the notification says Fee: EBC, SC, ST: Rs. 250; Other candidates: Rs. 1000 Pay: Rs. 19,900 per month consolidated Age limit: 18 to 30 years (as on 20 December 2026) Place: IGIMS, Patna

rows.indira_gandhi_institute_of_medical_scien: Valid Driving License for driving heavy vehicles, knowledge of Motor Mechanism and 03 years' experience. Desirable: 8th passed with 03 years' service as Home Guard/Civil Volunteer.

content_sections.heading: IGIMS Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 04/Driver/IGIMS/Estt./2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download IGIMS notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Valid Driving License for driving heavy vehicles; Knowledge of Motor Mechanism; Experience 03 Years Experience: 03 Years Age limit: 18 to 30 years (as on 20 December 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST 05 years, EBC (MBC)/BC 03 years, Female candidates (all categories) 03 years, Handicapped As per rule of Govt. of Bihar, Persons working in Government As per rule Other conditions: Open to Indian citizens Reservation and age relaxation benefits only for Bihar State domicile; applicants from outside Bihar not entitled to reservation Post is non-practicing; private practice of any kind is prohibited and leads to termination Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification Desirable: 8th passed with 03 years' service as Home Guard/Civil Volunteer

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for IGIMS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Employed candidates who do not submit a No Objection Certificate from the employer will not be considered for selection Applications arriving after 20-12-2026, 4:30 PM will not be received or accepted

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Contract valid for a maximum of three years, subject to extension on per year basis on satisfactory performance OR appointment on regular basis, whichever is earlier Only consolidated remuneration is applicable

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Demand Draft payable to The Director, IGIMS, Patna (non-refundable).

rows.event: Last date of receipt of application (till 4:30 PM)

content_sections.heading: How Will IGIMS Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written Test (Objective/Multiple Choice Questions) Skill Test Written Test with Objective/Multiple Choice Questions

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Educational and experience certificates (self-attested photocopies) Passport size photograph Demand Draft for the application fee Proof of age Caste Certificate from the Circle Officer with Domicile Certificate (SC/ST/EBC/BC; EBC/BC with creamy layer exemption)

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IGIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 20 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IGIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies for Driver (Ordinary Grade).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IGIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Proforma attached with the advertisement (page 3); also downloadable from www.igims.org) and send it to The Director, IGIMS, Patna-14, Bihar, by registered post / speed post / courier, to reach by 20 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: EBC, SC, ST: Rs. 250. Other candidates: Rs. 1000.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 30 years (as on 20 December 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST 05 years, EBC (MBC)/BC 03 years, Female candidates (all categories) 03 years, Handicapped As per rule of Govt. of Bihar, Persons working in Government As per rule.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 19,900 per month consolidated.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Valid Driving License for driving heavy vehicles, knowledge of Motor Mechanism and 03 years' experience. Desirable: 8th passed with 03 years' service as Home Guard/Civil Volunteer.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open to Indian citizens. Reservation and age relaxation benefits only for Bihar State domicile; applicants from outside Bihar not entitled to reservation. Post is non-practicing; private practice of any kind is prohibited and leads to termination. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Employed candidates who do not submit a No Objection Certificate from the employer will not be considered for selection. Applications arriving after 20-12-2026, 4:30 PM will not be received or accepted.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written Test (Objective/Multiple Choice Questions). Skill Test. Written Test with Objective/Multiple Choice Questions.
